suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
SELECT
    dt.d_year,
    item.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
    item.i_brand AS brand,
    sum(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM date_dim AS dt
JOIN store_sales
    ON dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN item
    ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
WHERE item.i_manufact_id = 816
  AND dt.d_moy = 11
GROUP BY
    dt.d_year,
    item.i_brand,
    item.i_brand_id
ORDER BY
    dt.d_year,
    sum_agg DESC,
    brand_id
LIMIT 100
